Source-authored console text follows the repository's ASCII-only convention for Windows cp1252 safety. At the CLI entry point (src/sensemaking_skills/cli.py main), characters that the active output stream cannot encode are escaped as JSON-compatible Unicode sequences so commands do not report failure after writing state. User-supplied characters that the stream can encode are preserved, so emitted bytes are not universally ASCII or UTF-8.

claims.statement: Generic Level-2 contract validator checks declared artifact sections, main machine fields and recommendation fields; it preserves advisory findings in the existing severity-tagged JSON error envelope without making them blocking and keeps optional Section 15 metadata out of top-level brief field checks.

ADR 0024 requires Section 15 extended_analysis to remain entirely optional and non-blocking, including under strict generic recommendation checks. Its four dotted recommended metadata fields are not main machine-block keys; malformed or invalid supplied values are warnings owned by validate-brief.py, never grounds to reject an otherwise valid repository_sensemaking_brief.

The generic artifact validator's advisory findings (missing recommended fields and large-artifact section/field/excerpt caveats) are non-blocking. In --json output they must remain visible with severity warning in the existing errors array; valid and exit status are determined by blocking errors, not advisory entries. Sequential in-process validation must not carry warnings from another artifact.

claims.statement: At db821c25, the session-receipt contract defines one optional, one-way pointer: continuity.campaign_ref names repository-relative Campaign state when state must survive many sessions or actors (section 7). ADR 0029 places optional Campaign persistence in current product scope, and ADR 0032 (PROPOSED) describes the same receipt-to-Campaign pointer. The pointer gives receipts no authority over Campaign state.

At db821c25, the receipt validator checks campaign_ref when it is present: it must be a repository-relative path, and it must exist under the target repository when --target-repo is given. No module under src/ reads or writes session receipts or campaign_ref, and no Campaign workflow writes a reverse pointer. All 29 committed session receipts hold null, so the pointer is declared but unexercised. Campaign admission and completion receipts are a separate artifact.
